values.note: Daily: 30-amp electric site $45 (concrete pad or not), lakefront $52; 50-amp + water $50 (with concrete pad too), lakefront $57, non-lakefront with sewer $57. Genesee County residents and seniors get $2 off a night (senior rate by phone, 810-736-7100 ext. 6). Two vehicles included; visitor vehicles $10 a day. $45 fee to cancel or change within 3 days of check-in. A seasonal or daily boat-launch permit is needed to use the launch.

values.note: Online through Genesee County Parks' reservation system (WebTrac) or the parks office, 810-736-7100. Lakefront sites need 3 nights. Walk-in registration 8 am - 9:30 pm daily on a space-available basis. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm.

note: Genesee County Parks campground on the north shore of Holloway Reservoir (1,973-acre all-sports lake): wooded and lake-view sites, concrete or gravel pads depending on the site, boat launch, swimming at Buttercup Beach; alcohol-free. --Claude
